```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)


tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~""                           , ~Title                , ~Content                                                         , ~Assignment                                                                            ,
  "September 22 + September 24" , "Foundations of data" , glue::glue('<i class="fa-solid fa-book-open-reader fa-lg"></i>') , glue::glue('<font color="#e9ecef"><i class="fa-solid fa-pen-ruler fa-lg"></i></font>')
)
```

```{r}
#| label: show-tbl
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#|
tbl |>
  kbl(
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "rlcccc",
    table.attr = 'class="schedule-table"'
  ) |>
  kable_styling() |>
  column_spec(1, width = "20%", extra_css = "padding-right: 20px;") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "48%") |>
  column_spec(3:4, width = "8%")
```
